en: That has lived from age to age,
Here, brother, is a flag for you,
That I made with my own hand;
The nights I did not sleep,
Look at it, with three colours,
Let it flutter against the enemy,
A man must die but once,
But blessed is he who for his nation's
notes: Romanization: Hübschmann–Meillet, with ու as u, ը as ə, aspirates marked ʿ; the Armenian full stop ։ is written '.' and the ՝ as ','.
line 1.3: 'Յուր' and 'որդիքը' are the older spellings of 'իր' (its) and 'որդիները' (sons); the line can also be read 'its sons now call out: free, independent Armenia'.
line 4.1: 'մի է', literally 'is one': death is the same everywhere.
line 4.4: 'կզոհվի', 'will be sacrificed', i.e. gives his life.
